title: Tool call stack
description: Keep an agent’s work inspectable without exposing a wall of logs.
useCase: Keep an agent’s work inspectable without exposing a wall of logs.
interaction: Run the sequence and inspect a step
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: Illustrative tool calls; no network request or booking is made.
look: Dark green-charcoal page with a lighter rounded card listing three steps with circular status badges, chevrons and a monospace code line under the open step.
motion: Clicking a step expands its detail by easing grid rows from 0fr to 1fr over 220 ms as the chevron rotates 90°; the refresh button advances the running step.
adapt: Expansion is the `.reveal` grid with `transition: grid-template-rows 220ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)` and inline `gridTemplateRows`; `step` sets each `.node` state. Replace `tasks` and drive `step` from real tool-call events instead of the advance button.
